items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: The interviewee mentions Wayne only in the interviewer's question ('...when Miles first got Herbie, Tony, Ron and Wayne together?') and does not provide any personal response or narrative about his own relationship with Wayne in the provided context.

ctx.x: that’s one thing he was a master at. Miles was the master at finding the right guys. He didn’t change. You know? Miles never really changed as far as his playing. He just got the right cats under him because he knew what sound he was going for and he was like, okay, these young guys know the vibe boom-boom-boom-boom we’ll try the young vibe and then put my thing on top of it. And that was something.
Did you hear the story about when Miles first got Herbie, Tony, Ron and Wayne together?
